project_type: Express.js REST API + MongoDB Atlas + Vanilla JS frontend with Tailwind CSS CDN
test_framework: Jest with Supertest for API integration tests, MongoDB Memory Server for test database
build_command: No separate build step - Node.js runtime execution
test_command: npm test (runs all tests with coverage), npm run test:integration (integration tests only), npm run test:unit (unit tests only)
verification_instructions: Run `npm test` to execute all tests with Jest and verify >94% coverage goal. Integration tests use MongoDB Memory Server. Tests are in tests/integration/ (API tests) and tests/unit/ (unit tests). Each test file uses require('../setup') for database initialization and cleanup.
snapshot_or_generated_files: coverage/ directory generated by Jest with lcov-report/index.html. Not checked into git.
environment_constraints: MongoDB Atlas connection requires DNS fix on Windows (handled in start-server.js with dns.setServers). Tests use MongoDB Memory Server (in-memory). Development server runs on port 5000 by default.
contribution_requirements: Follow MVC pattern: models/ for Mongoose schemas, controllers/ for business logic, routes/ for route definitions, middleware/ for reusable middleware. Use asyncHandler wrapper for async routes. Use express-validator for input validation. Maintain >80% test coverage (project aims for >94%). Use timestamps: true in Mongoose schemas. Follow existing error handling pattern with errorHandler middleware.
key_patterns: Controllers use asyncHandler(async (req, res) => {...}) pattern. Routes use express.Router() with validation middleware before controller. Models use Mongoose schema with timestamps. Tests use createTestStudent() factory from tests/utils.js. Validation uses express-validator with validate middleware. API responses are JSON with consistent structure. Pagination returns {data, pagination: {currentPage, totalPages, totalItems, limit, hasNextPage, hasPrevPage}}.
directory_structure: Root: app.js (Express app), server.js (server startup), start-server.js (DNS fix + startup). Subdirs: config/ (database.js for MongoDB connection), models/ (Mongoose schemas), controllers/ (business logic), routes/ (route definitions), middleware/ (asyncHandler, errorHandler, validator), public/ (index.html + app.js for frontend), tests/ (setup.js, utils.js, unit/, integration/)
